metadata.title: Equivalence on exponential families as Hessian manifolds and classification of exponential families of order 1 with constant Hessian sectional curvature
metadata.abstract: We introduce an equivalence relation on exponential families, and prove that two exponential families are equivalent in this sense if and only if the corresponding induced Hessian manifolds are isomorphic. Moreover, we classify exponential families of order 1 with constant Hessian sectional curvature. To this end, we show that for an exponential family of order 1, it has constant Hessian sectional curvature if and only if the natural exponential family equivalent to the given family has a quadratic variance function (NEF-QVF). The classification coincides with that of NEF-QVF by Morris (1982) essentially.

analysis.topic: 黎曼、亚黎曼、Finsler及特殊几何结构
analysis.workSummary: 把指数族的等价性与 Hessian 流形同构对应，并讨论一阶常 Hessian 截面曲率的分类。
techniques: 信息几何的 Hessian 结构
analysis.breakthrough: 把相应几何分类联系到已有 Morris 自然指数族二次方差函数分类。
analysis.limitations: 一阶和指定等价关系的条件重要；不应把既有统计分类重述为全部指数族的新分类。仅依据官方英文摘要及作者评论，尚未核查正文与完整证明；技术说明仅限摘要明确的信息，关键结论需回查原文。AI 披露另见独立核查记录；未检索到声明不代表没有使用 AI。

aiReview.note: 对该版本全部可提取页面做 AI 披露关键词检索，并核对命中段落；这不是对整篇数学证明的审读。

analysis.priorityReason: 提供几何与统计模型的清晰桥梁，但与几何分析核心方向间接。
